name: Mary Clare O'Donnell
headline: Investment Associate | Digital Strategist | Former Google News Fellow
location: United States, United States of America
summary:
Communications professional with a decade-long track record of crafting and executing impactful campaigns that foster audience engagement and drive growth. 

I've consistently built strategic partnerships and community initiatives to amplify brands and achieve tangible results, including substantial growth in subscriber bases and web traffic.

My expertise spans newsletter growth initiatives, social media campaigns, and thought leadership development across nonprofits and tech sectors. I'm particularly passionate about empowering historically marginalized groups through strategic digital engagement and community-building efforts.

Highlights from my career include:

- Writing, designing, and video-editing a Schmidt Foundation-funded public health series that garnered a significant following during the pandemic.
- Securing media placements in prominent publications like Forbes, demonstrating strong PR capabilities.
- Honing strategic communications and audience engagement skills through a Google News Fellowship in UX Design and a Digital Strategist role at a Paris-based language company.

I hold an M.A. in International Politics and a dual degree in Tech Management, with a background in Sustainability and International Development Research. Throughout my academic journey, I contributed to high-impact projects such as a UN WFP foresight report on global hunger and political science research on alternative economic models in Mexico and India.

Passionate about community building from an early career stage, I began as a political organizer in Philadelphia and have since held several roles supporting refugee integration with NGOs in Europe. I am focused on using my skills as leverage towards building a better world, and spreading social justice through impact-oriented organizations, with strategic digital engagement and community empowerment.

company.tagline:
Accelerating economic evolution to regenerate people and planet


| Future Economy Forum | Secretariat
company.description:
NOW Partners Foundation has spent 35 years collaborating with leaders, organizations, and alliances to foster meaningful innovations and tangible change. Together, we build movements that aim to establish new mainstream approaches in regenerative land-use, related systems and industries, and broader business, finance, and leadership.

NOW Partners Foundation is a global partnership of 100+ senior cross-sector leaders and change experts and their teams, united to accelerate the economic evolution of multinationals, large family companies and systems institutions. We co-create and implement a new industry logic and concrete business models that respect our planetary boundaries and catalyze our full human potential.

NOW Partners Foundation supports its partners in their transition towards fully integrating business success with equitable benefit for all stakeholders, ranging from shareholders to Nature. We call this Regenerative Value Creation - successful business activities that address humanity’s most pressing challenges and opportunities.
